result.title: Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs
result.summary: Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TABHGR+：用 LLM 依列与任务描述生成规则，为表格行打弱标签，再按规则把语义相关行聚成超图做标签传播，并给超边赋标签自适应权重以提纯噪声标签，从而在零样本表格分类上以与数据规模无关的常数次 LLM 调用替代逐行提示。
AI.relevance_reason: 表格零样本任务与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「恒定 LLM 调用 + 超图迭代传播 + 自适应边权重」的廉价状态提纯思路，可能为 latent 状态的多轮更新、证据聚合与推理成本控制提供可核查的方法线索。
